points.text: • protease or named protease; water; $T = 30^\circ\text{–}40^\circ\text{C}$; all three points in each bullet required for [1]

M1: three amino acids in any ionic / non-ionic states [1]: $\text{HOOC–CH(NH}_2\text{)–CH(CH}_3\text{)CH}_2\text{CH}_3$ and $\text{HOCH}_2\text{–CH(NH}_2\text{)–COOH}$ and $\text{HOOC–CH(NH}_2\text{)–CH}_2\text{CH}_2\text{–COOH}$
M2: three amino acids in the correct ionic state for their conditions [1]
M1: permanent dipole-dipole; one group that will have a $\delta^{+}$ and another with $\delta^{-}$ e.g. CO, NH, COOH, OH; BOTH required [1]
M2: hydrogen bonds; one group that will have a $\text{H}^{\delta+}$, e.g. NH, OH and another with lone pair, e.g. NH, COOH, OH, $\text{CONH}_2$; BOTH required [1]
M3: ionic bonding; $\text{NH}_3^{+}$ and $\text{COO}^{-}$; BOTH required [1]
points.guidance: ALLOW: London forces; $\text{C}_4\text{H}_9$ groups or parts of these alkyl groups

points.text: M1: any structure containing one $\text{COOH}$ / $\text{COCl}$ and $\text{NH}_2$ groups in the same molecule [1]
M4: ethan(e)dioic acid or ethan(e)dioyl chloride [1]
